articles.title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
articles.snippet: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

articles.title: Nvidia Erases 2026 Gains as Republicans Threaten Jensen Huang With Subpoena
articles.snippet: The chipmaker has erased its 2026 gains as a suspected Chinese espionage case brings fresh scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
articles.snippet: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

articles.title: Binance Warns of Apple iOS Flaw That Could Expose iPhone Users' Private Keys
articles.snippet: Apple has not publicly confirmed the "worse_query" bug, which a researcher published days before its latest iOS security update.

articles.title: AI Chip Stocks Bounce After Global Rout—But Is the Bubble Starting to Burst?
articles.snippet: A Friday rebound offered relief after a historic selloff. The question now is whether politics and mounting debt could turn an AI correction into something much worse.
